signature.one_line: Two event phone clips under one static text colour condensed 3-line ask overlay plus quoted credential.
unique_devices: One static 3-line audience+ask overlay (long / short / long) in text colour heavy condensed sans with a thin dark outline and slight bulge warp, on from frame 0 to the last frame across every cut
Tiny quoted 3-word credential sub-line in a light geometric sans under the overlay
In-camera whip (fast handheld swing) instead of an edit transition to reach the payoff view
signature.why_it_works: The audience and the ask are readable in frame one; real event lighting proves the credential without words; one cut keeps it effortless.

hook.first_frame: Low-angle phone selfie under stage truss lights with flares, the 3-line text colour overlay already on screen over the face

structure.what: Low-angle selfie under stage lights, slow tilt down to the face; overlay names the audience and the ask
Hard cut to a handheld wide at the event: the speaker on the stage edge, crowd and photographers behind; fast swing away
Camera lands on the lit stage (backdrop, mic stand, performer)

background_text.how: text colour heavy condensed sans, sentence case, centred; line centres 41.0 / 46.0 / 52.2 % H (block 38.5-54.5 %, over the face); line 1 x 21.9-77.9 %, line 2 x 37.5-62.4 %, line 3 x 21.2-78.5 %; Anton 400 72 px (or ~85 px with scaleX 0.79); ~3 px dark outline + faint halo; subtle bulge warp; no entry, no exit, not tracked
~3 words inside quote marks, Poppins 600 30 px, same text colour, thin dark outline, centred at 56.3 % H (x 33.5-62.5 %)

broll_inserts.what: Event wide / stage view without the speaker
broll_inserts.how: Same handheld phone take continuing after the whip; full frame

layout.how: No letterbox, split or card; overlay centred in the middle band

camera.what: Low-angle selfie with slow tilt down
camera.how: Handheld, arm's length, lights and flares above the head
Swing of ~15 frames with motion blur at ~72 % lands on the stage

transitions.how: Selfie -> event wide, not on a beat (measured cut_hit_share 0.0)
~15-frame blurred handheld swing inside the second clip

other_text_spec.copy: 3-line audience + ask hook, ~8-10 words, broken long / short / long; sentence case; line 3 is a parenthetical aside; placeholder 'Headline here, lead words' / 'KEY WORD' / '(short aside here)'
other_text_spec.font_class: heavy condensed grotesque, lowercase with double-storey a, tall x-height; set with a bulge/arc warp (glyphs at line ends lean outward and are smaller)

closest_match.confidence: medium (weight and double-storey a match; original ~21 % narrower)

other_text_spec.stroke: thin dark outline #110503, ~3 px @1920 (estimated), plus a faint dark halo
other_text_spec.fit_note: the reference face is ~21 % narrower than Anton (width/height px ratio 0.78-0.80): exact look Anton 400 at ~85 px with transform scaleX(0.79) (estimated); without scaling use the balanced 72 px

animation.idle: none: static, not tracked to face or camera

other_text_spec.copy: ~3-word credential wrapped in quote marks with inner spaces (placeholder '“ lead words here “')
other_text_spec.font_class: geometric sans, semibold, much lighter and smaller than the hook
other_text_spec.color: same yellow, reads paler because it is small (brightest pixels #F1D074)
other_text_spec.stroke: thin dark outline like the hook (estimated)

style.look_intent: mid-contrast, natural saturation, neutral-warm night event footage: cool blue-white stage light, warm bulbs, phone-native and lightly graded

sound.music: music-only (beat periodicity 0.69, ~115 bpm estimate); steady, flat bed (loudness range 0.8 LU)
sfx: none; the single hard cut is not on a beat (measured cut_hit_share 0.0)
optional: whoosh under the in-camera whip

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: the user has 1-2 raw phone clips from an event, shoot or workplace and no voiceover
the message is a short audience call-out plus an ask (meet up, hire, partner, DM)
speed matters more than polish: one overlay, one cut
the setting itself proves the credential
avoid_when: the speaker talks to camera and needs captions
face-safe rules forbid text over the face (move the block to 18-34 % H instead)
the brand needs a polished, graded look
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B18 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B18.json) to this brand.
This blueprint has NO speech captions: one static 3-line hook overlay plus a credential sub-line held over 1-2 phone clips. If the edit has speech, caption it with its own spec and keep this overlay as the only title. Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} must stay >= 3:1 on the footage behind it, and {{ACCENT_2}} outline must be the darkest brand neutral so the text survives bright lights)
- {{TEXT}}: overlay and sub-line fill, default #FFCA00
- {{ACCENT}}: same as {{TEXT}} unless the brand wants one key word recoloured, default #FFCA00
- {{ACCENT_2}}: outline + halo, default #110503
- {{SURFACE}}: unused (no cards), default none
- {{CARD_BG}}: unused, default none
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}}: heavy condensed sans, default Anton 400 (original ~21 % narrower)
- {{FONT_BODY}}: credential sub-line, default Poppins 600
- {{HANDLE}}: not shown in the source; optional "@handle" can replace the credential sub-line
- {{LOGO}}: not shown in the source

OVERLAY
1. Copy: a 3-line audience + ask hook, ~8-10 words, broken long / short / long ("Headline here, lead words" / "KEY WORD" / "(short aside here)"). Sentence case; parentheses and curly quotes allowed.
2. {{FONT_DISPLAY}} in {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, 72 px (balanced). For the exact narrow look set Anton at ~85 px with transform: scaleX(0.79). Thin {{ACCENT_2}} outline ~3 px plus a faint {{ACCENT_2}} halo; no box.
3. Layout: centred; line centres at 41.0 %, 46.0 %, 52.2 % H (block 38.5-54.5 %); line 1 spans x 21.9-77.9 % (ink 5.08 % H), line 2 x 37.5-62.4 % (4.14 % H), line 3 x 21.2-78.5 % (4.3 % H). In the source the block sits over the face; if face-safe rules apply, move the whole block up to 18-34 % H keeping the same spacing.
4. Warp: slight bulge/arc (glyphs at the line ends a little smaller, leaning outward). Subtle; skip if unavailable.
5. Sub-line: ~3-word credential in quote marks, {{FONT_BODY}} 30 px, {{TEXT}} with a thin {{ACCENT_2}} outline, centred at 56.3 % H (x 33.5-62.5 %, ink ~1.41 % H).
6. Timing: both layers on screen from frame 0 to the last frame, completely static (no entry, exit or tracking), across every cut.

EDIT
7. Two clips: a low-angle selfie (~45 % of runtime, slow tilt down) then one hard cut to a handheld wide that proves the setting; reach the payoff view with an in-camera fast swing (~15 frames of motion blur) rather than an edit transition. No punch-ins, no end card.

SOUND: music only, steady bed (low loudness range); optional whoosh on the swing. Master to about -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.
GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: mid-contrast, natural saturation, neutral-warm night event light (cool stage whites, warm bulbs).

VERIFY before rendering: render the overlay with "KEY WORD" on line 2 at the stated px and measure:
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at 1.0 --box 0.15,0.499,0.85,0.546 --ink "#FFCA00:70"
  video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <render-file> --out <dir> --at 1.0 --box 0.15,0.439,0.85,0.482 --ink "#FFCA00:70"
Compute the expected ink height/width for the brand's actual lines with video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py ({{FONT_DISPLAY}} 72 px, or 85 px x scaleX 0.79); line 3 at the reference length should read ~4.3 % H, line 2 ~4.14 % H. Swap the --ink colour to {{TEXT}}. Line centres within +-1 % of frame height of 41.0 / 46.0 / 52.2 %.
